title: Emerald Design Group Launches Inaugural Workplace Design Summit
summary: The inaugural Summit will take place May 3–5, 2027, at the Mandalay Bay Convention Center in Las Vegas. The post Emerald Design Group Launches Inaugural Workplace Design Summit appeared first on Emerald .
body_markdown:
Emerald’s Design Group, a leading producer of North American design events and media, today announced the launch of the **Workplace Design Summit** , a new event dedicated to the design, technology, and innovation shaping modern commercial workspaces.


[Read the full Press Release](https://workplacedesign.com/news/emerald-design-group-launches-inaugural-workplace-design-summit/160794/)
